jurisdictions.applicable_law: Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities framework and Service Accessibility Regulations; exact operator applicability requires legal owner facts
jurisdictions.applicable_standard: Israeli Standard 5568; WCAG 2.2 AA used only as the internal quality floor for this delta

official_sources.requirement_summary: Official accessibility statement and service-arrangements guidance, updated 2026-04-15

legal_applicability.evidence: The released signal reports a supplier attribute only and does not claim legal compliance. Exact exemption and coordinator obligations require operator and legal-owner facts.

automated_scan.evidence: 1499 local regression tests passed; public DOM inspection confirmed the semantic link and disclosure.

keyboard.evidence: The compact signal is a native anchor and the detailed disclosure is a native button with expanded state.

focus.evidence: A dedicated focus-visible outline is included in the released CSS.

screen_reader.evidence: No independent assistive-technology session was completed in this scoped release.

headings_landmarks.evidence: The detailed disclosure exposes a level-2 heading inside the place content.

names_labels.evidence: Public accessible name is 'נגישות לנכים: למידע נוסף'; detailed control exposes expanded/collapsed state.

contrast.evidence: Visual inspection passed, but an independent numeric contrast audit was not run for the full site.

resize_zoom_reflow.evidence: The shared signal uses wrapping, max-width 100% and no fixed width.

mobile.evidence: Public 390x844 responsive inspection passed; the control has a 44px minimum target height.

forms_errors.reason: This delta does not add or change a form.

media_documents.reason: This delta does not add media or documents.

maps_third_party.reason: This delta does not change the map implementation.

language_direction.evidence: Hebrew label and details render RTL and inherit the approved Heebo/Assistant/Rubik product typography stack.

accessibility_statement.evidence: Expanded disclosure links to https://vii.spaplus.co/accessibility without claiming the place is legally compliant.

contact_and_arrangements.evidence: Disclosure advises confirming required arrangements directly with the place before booking.

independent_check.evidence: No independent legal or screen-reader checker was assigned for this scoped data-visibility repair.

blockers: A full legal-compliance claim remains blocked pending operator facts, independent legal review and assistive-technology testing.
